correctness.rationale: Geometric smoothness is proved in the cited source. The disjoint projective-chart formula and complete finite-field histogram algorithm count all points for 13 successive extensions; a distinct direct homogeneous calculation checks the first five. K3 cohomology and duality recover every coefficient of the degree-22 Frobenius polynomial from 11 counts (middle coefficient is nonzero and fixes the sign). Integer multiplication verifies the displayed factors; the two unused extension traces agree. Modulo-13 polynomial gcds certify irreducibility of the residual factor. Tate in characteristic two yields ranks 6 and 10; its 2-adic Newton hull has slopes 1/2, 1, and 3/2 of multiplicities 2, 18, and 2, proving height two.
